ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white dominance across approximately 90% of the visible surface, with a high-contrast low-intensity black perimeter along the margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid high-intensity white central region across both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation is contiguous along the leading edge, tips, and trailing edge. Discrete low-intensity focal spots are visible in the lower-medial and lower-lateral areas of the white surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, central V-shaped notch with an acute angle and significant vertical depth relative to the horizontal axis of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by numerous jagged peaks and valleys varying in pixel amplitude.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the leading edges tapering toward the tips, with a multi-segmented concave trajectory along the trailing edge leading to the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, roughly circular dark-intensity pixel clusters distributed across the lower quadrants of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-aligned linear pixel disruptions (dark streaks) visible on the right lobe surface, oriented diagonally; faint vertical linear disruptions are visible on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear rake marks on the surface of the right lobe and irregular deep indentations/notches along the trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, circular dark-pixel feature/indentation is visible near the distal tip of the left lobe.
